description: File a session transcript into this repo's store so list_transcripts and get_spine can find it. Needed when a session leaves nothing on this machine: a Cowork session running in the CLOUD keeps its transcript inside the container it ran in, and the desktop app holds only a composer draft and an evictable cache of a partial event stream. The container writes the file somewhere reachable and calls this. Re-importing OVERWRITES: a live session keeps growing, so a second export must replace the first rather than leave two near-identical candidates for the ranking to choose between.

from.description: Absolute path of the transcript to file (JSONL).

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository this session belongs to.

session_id.description: Identifier to store it under. Defaults to the source file's name.

name: import_session
